market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: The 'No to ten million Switzerland' initiative faces significant political opposition, with the Federal Council and Parliament recommending rejection. Historically, similar immigration-control initiatives have mostly failed, like the 2020 'For moderate immigration' (38% yes). The double majority requirement further lowers the chance of approval. I estimate a 25% true probability of passage, markedly below the 35.5% market-implied odds.
evidence_points: Only one immigration-restriction initiative (2014 mass immigration) passed in recent decades; subsequent ones, like 2020's limit initiative, were rejected by over 60%.
The Swiss Federal Council and a majority of parties oppose the initiative, signaling weak political support.
The double majority (popular and cantonal) adds an extra hurdle rarely overcome by initiatives without broad consensus.
